--- pipe_join_methods.sql
FROM LeftTable AS l
|> HASH JOIN RightTable AS r ON l.id = r.id
|> LOOKUP JOIN ThirdTable AS t USING(id)

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 14,
            Name:    "LeftTable",
          },
          As: &ast.AsAlias{
            As:    15,
            Alias: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 18,
              NameEnd: 19,
              Name:    "l",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeJoin{
        Pipe:   20,
        Op:     "INNER JOIN",
        Method: "HASH",
        Right:  &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 33,
            NameEnd: 43,
            Name:    "RightTable",
          },
          As: &ast.AsAlias{
            As:    44,
            Alias: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 47,
              NameEnd: 48,
              Name:    "r",
            },
          },
        },
        Cond: &ast.On{
          On:   49,
          Expr: &ast.BinaryExpr{
            Op:   "=",
            Left: &ast.Path{
              Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 52,
                  NameEnd: 53,
                  Name:    "l",
                },
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 54,
                  NameEnd: 56,
                  Name:    "id",
                },
              },
            },
            Right: &ast.Path{
              Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 59,
                  NameEnd: 60,
                  Name:    "r",
                },
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 61,
                  NameEnd: 63,
                  Name:    "id",
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      &ast.PipeJoin{
        Pipe:   64,
        Op:     "INNER JOIN",
        Method: "LOOKUP",
        Right:  &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 79,
            NameEnd: 89,
            Name:    "ThirdTable",
          },
          As: &ast.AsAlias{
            As:    90,
            Alias: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 93,
              NameEnd: 94,
              Name:    "t",
            },
          },
        },
        Cond: &ast.Using{
          Using:  95,
          Rparen: 103,
          Idents: []*ast.Ident{
            &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 101,
              NameEnd: 103,
              Name:    "id",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM LeftTable AS l |> INNER HASH JOIN RightTable AS r ON l.id = r.id |> INNER LOOKUP JOIN ThirdTable AS t USING (id)
